_comment: Copy to ai/config.json (or point FRESHIQ_CONFIG at it) to override AI defaults. Any subset of keys is allowed; unspecified values keep their code defaults. See ai/config.py. NOTE: this file tunes the MODEL side only. Rig settings (compartments, serial port, camera index) live in config/freshiq.json.
_WARNING_conditions: These MUST match models/labels.json 'classes' for the deployed model, which is ["fresh", "spoiled"]. An earlier version of this example shipped ["fresh","ripe","spoiled"] against a 2-output model: 'ripe' can never be predicted, so it sits at 0% forever and quietly misleads. Only add a third class if you retrain with real ripe data.
_WARNING_foods: The trained food head has EIGHT outputs. These are the exact classes in models/labels.json, in order. Adding names here does not teach the model anything - it only lets the heuristic fallback guess at them. Do not reorder.

quality._min_focus_variance: Lower to ~20 for soft laptop/phone cameras. A tray-mounted USB camera at a fixed distance is usually sharper.

model._input_size: 160 is what the deployed model actually takes (verified: input tensor is 1x160x160x3 float32). labels.json carries the real value and OVERRIDES this at load time, so the two cannot drift - it is listed here only for readability.
